svg.text: Submerged steam coil E-101 | Temperature-to-steam-flow cascade TIC-101 > FIC-201 | Level control on gravity outlet
• FT-201 orifice is downstream of TV-101.
• No outlet pump: drains on hydrostatic head.
• Conceptual: no relief, drains, vents or isolation.
Design basis: 15.0 m3/h feed at 25 degC | 75 degC bulk | level 2.0 m (6.28 m3, 25 min) | coil 898 kW | 1,533 kg/h steam at 6.0 barg | TV-101 and LV-101 ~50% at design
